newsitem.title: USA: Harborside Healthcare to acquire facility.
newsitem.headline: Harborside Healthcare to acquire facility.

text.p: Harborside Healthcare Corp said Wednesday that it will acquire Access Rehabilitation, headquartered in Boston, for an undisclosed price.

Access Rehabilitation, which had revenues of $7.5 million in 1996, provides contract physical, occupational and speech therapy services to skilled nursing facilities and home health agencies in Massachusetts, Rhode Island and Florida.
Access will be operated as a division of Theracor, Harborside's rehabilitative therapy service subsidiary.
Theracor provides contract therapy services to affiliated and non-affiliated skilled nursing facilities and had non-affiliated revenues of $10,300,000 in 1996.
The transaction is expected to close on July 1, 1997.
The company also said it has an agreement for a joint venture pharmacy with NeighborCare, a division of Genesis Health Ventures Inc.
The venture will provide pharmacy and infusion therapy services to nursing and assisted living facilities throughout the state of New Hampshire.
